description: Unit test for OpenAIChatService, specifically testing error handling when an invalid API key is used. It defines a fake HTTP client to simulate a 401 Unauthorized response from the OpenAI API and verifies that the service correctly surfaces the error details.

classes.name: _FakeClient
classes.description: A fake HTTP client subclassing http.BaseClient, used to mock HTTP responses for testing.

methods.name: _FakeClient.<constructor>
methods.description: Initializes the fake client with a custom request handler.

methods.name: _FakeClient.send
methods.description: Overrides the send method to use the provided handler to simulate HTTP responses.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Defines the test case for error handling in OpenAIChatService when an invalid API key is used.
